scenarios.title: Grounded answer with citations
scenarios.behavior: Given a Tenant with an uploaded policy document, when a User asks 'What is our refund policy for enterprise customers?', then the Answer is grounded in the Tenant's documents and includes >=1 Citation (document, section locator, retrieval score) and abstained=false.

scenarios.title: Abstention on insufficient evidence
scenarios.behavior: Given a Tenant whose documents contain no information about a topic, when a User asks an on-topic-but-uncovered question, then the system returns abstained=true with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and returns ZERO citations (no fabricated sources).

scenarios.title: Citations always point to real chunks
scenarios.behavior: For any Answer, every Citation references an existing Chunk of that Tenant's Documents; the evaluation runner rejects any answer citing absent entities.

scenarios.title: New document becomes retrievable
scenarios.behavior: Given an uploaded Document (POST /documents), when it completes registration, then a subsequent retrieval over its domain content returns chunks of that document (proven by offline test with fixed index).

scenarios.title: Controlled action requires confirmation (Month 3 contract)
scenarios.behavior: When a User requests 'create a ticket', the system validates the permission, then requires explicit confirmation; if the confirmation is absent the Action must not execute; if permission fails, the Action must not execute.
scenarios.note: Contract-level scenario now; implementation arrives with COPILOT-PORTFOLIO

scenarios.title: Cost and latency are recorded per operation
scenarios.behavior: Every LLM call and retrieval records usage (tokens, latency; cost when available) such that a per-operation cost report can be produced later (INV4).

scenarios.title: Evaluation regression gate
scenarios.behavior: Given the golden case set, when the retrieval path changes, running the evaluation runner produces a JSON report and exits non-zero if hit-rate degrades below the configured threshold.

scenarios.title: Health is honest
scenarios.behavior: GET /health returns service status/version without external calls; never reports healthy dependencies it did not check.
